_doc: Man .tsx duoi apps/mobile/src/screens VA apps/mobile/src/rudi/screens ma KHONG file nao dang song render.
Do bang scripts/check_screens_reachable.py, goc la cac route app/** (package.json main = expo-router/entry). Lan cap nhat: 2026-09-03.
Day la DANH SACH NO, khong phai danh sach mien. Moi dong o day la mot man
da viet xong, da typecheck, va khong nguoi nao mo duoc -- vi khong co gi
render no. Cong DO voi bat ky man nao nhu vay ma KHONG co trong file nay,
nen danh sach chi dung yen hoac ngan di; no khong tu dai ra trong im lang.
'reason' la BAT BUOC: thieu no thi cong exit 2. Mot danh sach ngoai le
khong ly do la thu khong ai phan biet duoc voi mot cai nhun vai. Ly do phai
noi CAI GI CON THIEU, de nguoi doc sau kiem duoc thay vi phai tin.
Noi duoc man nao thi cong in GHIM CU va bao go dong do -- mot pin song lau
hon thu no bao che la mot loi khong ai kiem lai.

screens.reason: ADR-0008/ADR-0009: man cho xem AI doc duoc gi tu doan chat, moi so kem dung tin nhan no doc ra. Khong noi duoc bang mot dong import: ca tinh nang trich xuat la mot hon dao -- src/extraction.ts va src/fixtures/threads.ts cung khong co duong vao, va khong man song nao dung ra mot `Extraction` de truyen cho no. Noi duoc khi co luong 'AI doc doan chat -> de xuat khoan chi' trong src/screens/chat/ (lane frontend). Go pin cung luc do; cong se tu nhac neu quen.
